_provenance.invariant: Scheduling identities: ORGANIZER is the eXo organizer (not the pushing account) and carries SCHEDULE-AGENT=CLIENT because the pusher (identity 5) is not the organizer (identity 9); every ATTENDEE carries SCHEDULE-AGENT=CLIENT and a PARTSTAT mapped from the agenda response; a CN holding a comma is quoted; an attendee without a visible email is omitted entirely. SCHEDULE-AGENT is CLIENT, as captured. It was briefly NONE for EXO-89681 and put back once a real client showed the cost: macOS Calendar offered Accept and Decline on a NONE copy, edited the object when the user pressed one, and left PARTSTAT untouched — so the answer never reached the object the verification pass reads.
